newsitem.title: UK: Colombia plans $500-$750 mln 10-yr global - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Colombia plans $500-$750 mln 10-yr global - dealers.

text.p: Colombia has taken bids from banks for a $500 million to $750 million 10-year global bond issue, syndicate managers said on Wednesday.
A mandate for the transaction was expected soon, they said, with U.S. banks likely to be appointed as lead managers.
"There is talk J.P. Morgan and Merrill Lynch could be in with a strong chance of winning the mandate," said a syndicate manager at another U.S. house.
Officials at J.P. Morgan declined to comment.
Colombia planned to raise $1.8 billion in the international bond markets this year, including a $750 million 30-year bond in the U.S., it said in December.
It launched a $400 million five-year Eurobond last May at 150 basis points over U.S. Treasury notes via Salomon Brothers and SBC Warburg.
